jobs.title: SAP IS-U Billing Analyst
jobs.description:
**SAP IS\-U Billing Analyst** with Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a combination of education and experience equating to the U.S. equivalent of a Bachelor’s degree in one of the aforementioned subjects.


**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Lead end\-to\-end analysis, solution design, configuration, implementation, and optimization of SAP IS\-U Billing and Invoicing processes across large\-scale utility environments.
* Translate complex business and regulatory requirements into functional specifications and scalable SAP IS\-U solutions, evaluating design alternatives, conducting fit\-gap assessments, and ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture governance standards.
* Design and configure SAP IS\-U Billing Master Data, Billing Schemas, Rate Categories, Rate Types, Rates, Operands, Facts, Price Keys, and Rate Determination procedures.
* Lead functional design for complex utility billing scenarios, including Time\-of\- Use billing, interval\-based billing, gas thermal and volumetric billing, billing simulations, proration, adjustments, reversals, rebilling, and exception management.
* Analyze utility tariff structures, rate changes, and billing requirements, assessing functional impacts and dependencies across Meter Reading, Invoicing, FI\-CA, and Customer Service.
* Define and oversee integration between SAP IS\-U Billing, Device Management, Energy Data Management (EDM), SAP CRM, FI\-CA, and external metering and financial systems to support end\-to\-end Meter\-to\-Cash operations.
* Design billing validation and reconciliation processes to ensure accurate consumption calculations, invoice generation, financial postings, and resolution of billing discrepancies.
* Participate in SAP S/4HANA Utilities transformation initiatives, including brownfield conversions, solution assessments, functional impact analysis, integration planning, and business process modernization.
* Design and support billing enhancements involving advanced metering, interval\-data integration, electric vehicle charging, tariff changes, and evolving utility business requirements.
* Investigate complex SAP IS\-U Billing production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, assess cross\-module dependencies, recommend corrective solutions, and support billing process automation and continuous improvement.
* Lead functional design workshops and solution reviews, preparing architecture documentation, implementation estimates, and technical recommendations for complex enterprise SAP initiatives.
* Provide functional guidance to onshore and offshore teams, reviewing configurations, functional specifications, integration designs, and development deliverables while resolving cross\-functional dependencies.
* Coordinate system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect resolution, billing\-cycle transitions, production deployments, and post\-Go\-Live stabilization, collaborating with technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
**Skills / Work Experience Required:**


* Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible experience in SAP consulting, enterprise application implementation, solution design, or large\-scale IT delivery, including extensive experience with SAP IS\-U solutions.
* Expert functional knowledge of SAP IS\-U Billing and Invoicing, including Billing Master Data, Billing Schemas, Rate Management, Operands, Facts, Rate Determination, Billing Exceptions, and Invoice Processing.
* Advanced knowledge of utility tariffs, Time\-of\-Use billing, interval\-based billing, gas billing, collective invoicing, billing reversals, adjustments, budget billing, and complex Meter\-to\-Cash processes.
* Extensive experience integrating SAP CRM/ECC/IS\-U with Device Management, Meter Reading, Energy Data Management, FI\-CA, Customer Service, and external utility and financial systems.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Utilities implementations, brownfield conversions, functional assessments, application modernization, and enterprise transformation programs.
* Strong technical understanding of SAP Fiori, SAP UI5, OData services, APIs, middleware, microservices, and cloud integration technologies, including AWS or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), Meter Data Management Systems (MDMS), SAP EDM profiles, interval\-data processing, and enterprise data integration.
* Demonstrated expertise in enterprise solution architecture, functional design, fit\-gap analysis, technical governance, application integration, and business process optimization.
* Proven experience delivering complex SAP implementations, including requirements analysis, functional specifications, testing, deployment, production support, and system stabilization.
* Experience working with geographically distributed onshore and offshore teams using Agile and Waterfall methodologies, including cross\-functional delivery coordination and technical guidance.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills, with demonstrated ability to independently resolve complex enterprise application issues. SAP IS\-U, SAP CRM, SAP S/4HANA, or related SAP professional certifications preferred.
Work location is Portland, ME with required travel to client locations throughout USA.
  

  

Rite Pros is an equal opportunity employer (EOE).

565 Congress St, Suite \# 305
  

Portland, ME 04101\.

jobs.title: SAP FI Analyst
jobs.description:
**Enterprise Performance**


Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions


**Position Summary**


**SAP FI Analyst**


Are you looking for a career trajectory that few other organizations can offer in SAP? With a high\-quality portfolio of businesses and clients, opportunities to work across capabilities, industries, and geographies in roles and on projects aligned with your SAP Finance skills, if this matches your interests and aspirations, Deloitte may be the right fit for you.


**Work you’ll do**


SAP FI Analyst at Deloitte is responsible for ensuring quality solutions are provided to our clients which not only solve the problem at hand but also have longevity and can be easily maintained. Few of the key areas a FI Consultant is involved in are mentioned below:


* Conduct As\-Is and To\-Be business process workshops while working on implementation project
* Map Business Processes to SAP
* Configure SAP to reflect the business requirements.
* Write Functional Specification / Configuration documents.
* Exhibit effective communication while working with cross\-functional and technical teams

**The Team:**


Deloitte’s SAP Service Line is among the world’s largest, with 8,000 global practitioners and over 1,700 SAP implementation projects completed. More than half our consultants have 10\+ years of experience, and Deloitte has been an SAP Global Partner — Services since 1989\. We offer a full range of SAP services, from business case development to deployment, supported by nine solution centers and proprietary accelerators that enhance project delivery. Our CMMI Level 5 and SAS 70\-certified practice covers S4 Hana, CRM, NetWeaver, BO, Development, BASIS \& Infrastructure, and serves all functional areas and industry sectors


**Qualifications**:


**Must have skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**


* 2\-3 years of industry experience
* Domain experience is required for Senior Consultant but is good to have at Consultant level
* GL – New GL with Segment Reporting
* Accounts Receivable / FSCM, Accounts Payable / Banking, Cost Center Accounting, Cost Element Accounting \& Internal Orders, Project Systems, Investment Management, Asset Accounting, Product Costing,
* Worked on implementation project of the most recent version
* Should have run Blueprint Workshop and should be able to map Business Processes to SAP
* Should have Industry Experience.

**Good to have skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**


* COPA\- FICA, PSCD, FSCD, Cash Management, Treasury
* Cross process area experience in Product Costing, FSCM, FICA, PSCD and FSCD

**Education:**


* BE/B. Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc. (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Locations**


* Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune

  

  

**Our purpose**  

  

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
**Our people and culture**  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
**Professional development**  

  

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills.
